fusions.name: Tumbling Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to the target, then a rolling blow deals 16 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Rolling Rampage
fusions.desc: Rolls over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Seamless Roll
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds and your dodge chance by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Overlapped Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.8 health a second, permanently.
